verdict.rationale: Conductor is a native desktop (Mac) app that runs multiple coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel, each in its own workspace/branch/worktree with a dedicated diff and review path before opening a PR, and community users independently confirm the git-worktree-based parallel session model. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evaluation specifically praising the visual diff-review UI's quality/UX (only vendor docs describe the diff view) and no screenshots/video corroboration.
